about: A small MCP server both suites start, over stdio and over Streamable HTTP, to prove the agent-file mcp client end to end (2026-09-26). TypeScript: tests/fixtures/mcp-echo-server.mjs; Python: tests/fixtures/mcp_tool/echo_server.py. Each takes `--http <port>` to serve Streamable HTTP at `http_path` instead of stdio. Named `server_name` in an agent file, its tools get the names in `qualified` (config_shapes.json, naming); `calls` are what each returns as text.
